translations.web: “Go away from here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.
translations.bsb: “Leave here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the Brook of Cherith, east of the Jordan.
translations.kjv: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
